_meta.purpose: Splits whose seam the stored price history may still carry: scripts/repair_history_seams.py finds the one unreverted step of about 1/factor before each ex-date and divides the bars before it by the factor. Hand-maintained; add a split only once its ex-date and ratio are checked against the exchange's notice.
_meta.fields: ticker (registry id), ex_date (first day of trading in the split shares), factor (new shares per old share), source
